Located in the thriving Boxing Economic Development Zone of Binzhou City, Shandong Province, China, **Shandong Binzhou Huike Cyclodextrin Technology Co., Ltd.** stands as a leading high-tech chemical enterprise dedicated to the innovative research, development, production, and commercialization of cyclodextrin and its derivatives. Capitalizing on the rich industrial resources and strategic logistical advantages of the Shandong region, the company has rapidly established itself as a premier, deeply specialized supplier within the global fine chemical industry.

At its core, Huike Cyclodextrin Technology focuses on manufacturing a comprehensive portfolio of high-quality cyclodextrin products. This includes standard alpha, beta, and gamma cyclodextrins, as well as highly specialized derivatives such as Hydroxypropyl-beta-cyclodextrin. These advanced chemical compounds serve as crucial ingredients across a multitude of global sectors. They play vital roles in pharmaceutical drug formulations, food and beverage processing, cosmetics, environmental protection, textiles, and various industrial applications. By enhancing the solubility, stability, and bioavailability of active ingredients, Huike’s products empower clients to achieve superior end-product performance.

The company distinguishes itself through a steadfast commitment to technological innovation and rigorous quality control. Equipped with state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and a highly skilled R&D team, Shandong Binzhou Huike continuously optimizes its production processes to ensure efficient, sustainable, and eco-friendly manufacturing. Adhering to strict international quality management standards, the company guarantees exceptional purity and consistency in every batch it produces. Driven by a customer-centric philosophy, Huike Cyclodextrin Technology is dedicated to providing tailored chemical solutions, comprehensive technical support, and reliable service, thereby forging long-lasting, mutually beneficial partnerships with clients both in domestic markets and across the globe.
